outcome_rules.directional_support: Valid original chain with HJB converged and primary strictly below 4.296031910596614; report exact delta; still not a solved steady state
outcome_rules.falsifier: Valid HJB return is nonconverged by100 iterations, or valid original chain returns primary>=4.296031910596614; H03 not supported. Do not rescue with a secondary endpoint.
outcome_rules.mixed: Primary improves while original stationary residual or mass/sign diagnostics worsen: retain mixed outcome; no strict acceptance
outcome_rules.arithmetic_uncertainty: If a difference is comparable to separately recorded CSR/dense arithmetic variation, call direction inconclusive; do not add an acceptance tolerance
outcome_rules.inconclusive: Timeout/memory/domain/observer/pin/grid/capture/unknown or missing return stops; do not call these100-iteration nonconvergence
outcome_rules.completion: Whatever result, seal, offline analysis and stop; no automatic next price or widened grid

failure_policy: Sole dispatch spent; preserve failure; zero retry or renamed successor
